rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person, machine, or service that is reliable.

example.english: This washing machine is still trusty after all these years.
example.traditional: 呢部洗衣機用咗咁多年，仲係好靠得住。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 jung6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 zung6 hai6 hou2 kaau3 dak1 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that a person, source, or product is trustworthy and can be trusted.

example.english: This source is trusty, so everyone can safely cite it.
example.traditional: 呢個消息來源信得過，大家可以放心引用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 loi4 jyun4 seon3 dak1 gwo3 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 jan5 jung6
